known_outcome: Determination (19 June 2023, s 188): the level-threshold showers constructed without inbuilt seating or handrails do not comply with clause G1.3.4 and so do not comply to the extent required by the Act (p.10 §6.1). Reasoning: a removable seat relies on management practice, which cannot establish compliance (p.9-10 §4.23-4.24, citing Determination 2011/112); the level threshold alone does not meet G1.3.4 (p.10 §4.25); movable shower chairs may be added in addition to the required fixtures (p.10 §4.26).
review_focus: Whether the answer identifies G1.3.4 as the performance test and treats the alternative-solution route as a performance argument, not a clause exemption.
Whether it flags that management practices such as removable furniture were not accepted as building features.
Whether it notes the consent plans' accessible-shower annotation and asks for the accessibility report.
Whether it asks about ODI or disability-agency consultation for resubmission.
Whether it avoids stating that the showers comply.
